source='''def transform(grid):
    """Extend any diagonal run of matching non-background cells to the edge,
    stopping when it meets another non-background cell."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    # Collect all original cells by color. A ray is triggered by a diagonal
    # neighbor of the same color; extension starts beyond each end of a run.
    dirs = ((1, 1), (1, -1))
    for dr, dc in dirs:
        for r in range(h):
            for c in range(w):
                color = grid[r][c]
                if color == bg:
                    continue
                nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
                if not (0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and grid[nr][nc] == color):
                    continue
                # Only start at the first cell of a contiguous diagonal run.
                pr, pc = r - dr, c - dc
                if 0 <= pr < h and 0 <= pc < w and grid[pr][pc] == color:
                    continue
                er, ec = r, c
                while 0 <= er + dr < h and 0 <= ec + dc < w and grid[er + dr][ec + dc] == color:
                    er, ec = er + dr, ec + dc
                for ar, ac, sr, sc in ((r - dr, c - dc, -dr, -dc), (er + dr, ec + dc, dr, dc)):
                    while 0 <= ar < h and 0 <= ac < w and grid[ar][ac] == bg:
                        out[ar][ac] = color
                        ar += sr
                        ac += sc
    return out
'''
